channel.title: Apache Software Foundation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Apache Software Foundation (apache).

item.title: CVE-2026-59267 · 5.8 MEDIUM — Apache OpenOffice: Heap Buffer Overflow in DXF LWPOLYLINE import could cause memory corruption
item.description: A crafted DXF document causes a heap buffer overflow in Draw in Apache OpenOffice 4.1.16 and earlier. This could cause a crash or otherwise a corruption of memory areas. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 4.1.17, which fixes this issue.
